scope: 本次指定10张中的003-s02、003-s03、003-s04；接续已完成003-s01，未改动既有图片或总记录。
sequence_note: 003图组顺序：s01→s02→s01→s03→s01→s04→s01；每个方向先回准备位，非连续甩腿。
generation_notes: 每张单独调用一次内置image_gen，以同一003-s01为编辑目标并附原始身份参考；逐张实际看图确认后另存，不覆盖原图。

items.phase_zh: 左手扶栏、左脚支撑不移位，右脚向前点足尖轻触。
items.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: scientific-educational, realistic rehabilitation STEP photograph for E-GEN-003 supported multidirectional ground toe touches.
INPUT IMAGES: Image 1 is the exact scene and camera EDIT TARGET: existing step 003-s01. Images 2–4 are strict identity/clothing/lighting references of the SAME adult East Asian woman. Preserve this same face, age, body build, black low ponytail, white short-sleeved T-shirt, charcoal full-length trousers, and white unbranded low-top shoes.
INVARIANTS: Preserve image 1's entire landscape 1536x1024 3:2 frame, camera viewpoint, lens, subject scale, head/torso position, gray-blue seamless studio background and floor, soft lighting and subtle shadows, and the EXACT gray metal fixed handrail on viewer RIGHT with two bolted supports. Her anatomical LEFT hand stays in the SAME visible real contact with the rail; left forearm stays natural. Her anatomical LEFT SUPPORT FOOT is the viewer-right shoe near pixel (816,875): keep it firmly planted in the EXACT same floor location, supporting her weight. Right arm remains relaxed by her side. Only re-pose the anatomical RIGHT TEST LEG (viewer-left leg) with minimal natural support-knee adjustment; do not move the left shoe, relocate body or rail, change camera or scale.
FLOOR MARKERS: Keep exactly the SAME THREE dark-gray flat circular floor dots at their original positions. Approximate centers in image 1: front dot (681,961), diagonal-right-forward dot (557,921), lateral-right dot (520,873). These screen coordinates only identify original objects, never add printed coordinates or labels. Do not draw lines/connectors/arrows or add marks; maintain three dots even if one is partially covered by touching toe. All remain in the same physical ground plane.
Body has coherent normal anatomy, two arms/two legs, natural hands, continuous hip/knee/ankle connections. Entire head, hands, rail, both complete shoes and targets visible. Single still pose only; no collage/inset, ghost motion, text, labels, numbers, arrows or watermark. Toe touch means ONLY the FRONT TOE of the testing shoe gently contacts the floor target with HEEL visibly elevated; bodyweight stays over planted left support foot. No full-sole step or weight transfer to test foot, no lunge, high kick, squat, crossed legs or unstable knee.
STEP 003-s02, FORWARD TOE TOUCH: From the ready stance in image 1, extend her anatomical RIGHT leg modestly straight FORWARD to the ORIGINAL NEAREST FRONT dot at (681,961), directly in front of her original right shoe along her body's forward axis (toward image foreground, not sideways). Her right knee may bend softly; the RIGHT TOE clearly touches that FRONT dot, heel lifted about 4–8 cm, sole tilted down at toe. The other two dots at diagonal and lateral positions remain unobstructed. Upright calm torso, eyes forward, left hand on rail and left foot supporting exactly as in base. This must read as supported forward toe-reach, not walking onto the target.

QA.observations: 已实际看图：同一女性外貌/黑马尾/白T深灰裤白鞋，灰蓝背景柔光一致；全身、双鞋、左手扶栏接触完整。右测试腿向前伸，鞋前端轻触前点、鞋身抬起；左脚保持原位接地，斜前与侧点位置不变且可见。相机、栏杆、三点、人物尺度与s01保持；无文字、箭头或连接线。
